Merge main into the self-hosted sharing branch (the new share_relay project lands as described in this PR's sibling entries).

Review fixes on top: the rendered frps.toml now sets `tlsVerify = true` on the connector-auth plugin (frp otherwise skips certificate verification on https plugin addrs); deploy staging keeps the secret-bearing artifacts owner-only on both ends and removes the remote staging dir after install; Cloudflare DNS errors with non-JSON bodies surface as RelayDnsError; the healthcheck-port comment describes its real (publicly reachable, liveness-only) exposure; and the plugin-auth URL is validated via AnyHttpUrl instead of type-checker ignores.

Second review pass: the remote install downloads frp inside a private mktemp dir and the staging mkdir fails loudly if the fixed /tmp path is raced back into existence; `render` writes its secret-bearing artifacts owner-only; a plugin-auth URL carrying a query/fragment is rejected at configuration time instead of silently losing it; the DNS upsert deletes stale duplicate A records; cloud-init refreshes the apt cache before installing packages; and the README no longer claims the relay holds no credentials.

Third review pass: the content domain is a validated primitive (dot-joined DNS labels) so typos fail at configuration time; the cloud-init and healthcheck deploy assets ship inside the package (the installed wheel previously raised FileNotFoundError on provision/deploy); and reusing a project SSH key by name now requires matching key material, failing loudly after a rotation instead of provisioning an unreachable instance.
